# HeyTea Menu

> > Comprehensive menu guide for HeyTea, the premium bubble tea brand featuring signature drinks like Cloud Matcha, fruit teas, cheese teas, and seasonal beverages with pricing across multiple countries.

HeyTea Menu provides up-to-date pricing and product information for HeyTea's beverage offerings including their popular Cloud series, fruit tea combinations, matcha specialties, and customization options. The site covers menus for various international markets including the UK, France, and Germany.

## Key Topics

- HeyTea bubble tea chain
- Cloud Matcha specialty drinks
- Fruit tea combinations
- Cheese tea beverages
- Milk tea varieties
- Seasonal drinks menu
- Matcha drinks & Japanese tea
- Customization toppings (boba, jellies, sago)
- Popular drinks: Guava Green Grape, Green Grape Boom, Coconut Mango Boom
- Signature items: Cloud Jasmine Tea, Peachy Mango Ice, Strawberry Fizz
- Menu pricing by country
- Ceremonial matcha beverages
- Fruit tea flavors: mango, grapefruit, lychee, pineapple
- Tea shop customization options
